content: {"rulings":[{"chargeId":"c1","decision":"convicted","reason":"The removal of the dot check in hasCustomProtocol unintentionally treats dotted protocols as custom, causing them to be returned unchanged instead of normalized; the original code explicitly excluded dotted protocols from custom handling."},{"chargeId":"c2","decision":"convicted","reason":"The same change causes 'foo.bar://' to be incorrectly treated as a custom protocol and returned unchanged instead of being normalized to 'http://foo.bar', which the defense concedes is a regression."}]}
